Full job description
Awarded Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces for the fifth year in a row!

AccountingDepartment.com is the leader in outsourced virtual accounting services for businesses - and our family is growing! Perhaps your next career adventure awaits!
AccountingDepartment.com never settles with status quo. We strive to make sure our staff have plenty of opportunities that broaden skill sets and ultimately enhance career satisfaction while working here. If you're someone who wants to make a difference, is a confident communicator, loves a good challenge, and happily embraces change, then we sound like a perfect match!
It's been an exciting 22 years at AccountingDepartment.com! We hope you will join us as we continue this exciting revolutionary journey we are on.
Your Role:
The Proposal Architect serves as a critical bridge between Revenue Generation and Implementation, ensuring a smooth and informed transition from prospect to client.
This role begins with a detailed review of prospective clients’ existing QuickBooks files and/or financial reports to identify risks, complexities, and discussion points for the File Review call. The Proposal Architect participates in the File Review call, captures key insights, and prepares proposal documents that accurately reflect the client’s needs, scope, and estimated effort.
Once a prospect becomes a client, the Proposal Architect prepares and delivers all relevant documentation to the Implementation team to support a seamless onboarding experience. The role remains engaged post handoff to assist with offboarding questions, learn from outcomes, refine assumptions, and continuously improve the proposal and sales process.
This is an exceptional opportunity for a highly analytical, detail oriented accountant who thrives in a fast paced, collaborative environment. Overtime may be required to meet project deadlines.
Proposal Architect responsibilities may be performed entirely within proposal development or in combination with client accounting work, skill alignment, and business needs. Team members who choose to maintain client responsibilities will split their time between proposal development and client service. This approach allows team members to keep their technical and client facing skills sharp and build valuable experience in proposal development at the same time. Time allocation will be determined collaboratively and may be adjusted over time.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
Review and analyze prospects' existing QuickBooks file and/or financial reports; prepare detailed analysis for use during data file review call with prospects, including specific topics that should be covered during the review
Participate in File Review calls, take detailed notes, and highlight items requiring further clarification or follow up
Engage in fact finding with prospective clients, when necessary, to understand business processes and operational nuances
Apply analytical and critical thinking to translate file review findings into insights and recommendations for proposals
Prepare draft proposal documents and time estimate worksheets in accordance with ADC terms and conditions
Partner with Proposal Management to finalize proposal options and ensure accuracy and completeness
Review individual contracts for completeness and understand the intricacies
Reassess and amend contracts when scope, assumptions, or client needs change
Identify opportunities to improve the data file review, proposal preparation, and handoff process
Attend weekly Proposal Department and Sales Department meetings
Serve as a resource to Implementation during onboarding process
Ability to work outside normal hours as needed to meet objectives
Essential Skills & Experience:
Strong alignment with AccountingDepartment.com’s mission and core values
Desire to act as a positive role model and trusted partner across teams
Strong knowledge of fundamental bookkeeping and accounting principles, practices and procedures
Strong knowledge of accounting fundamentals and practical experience reviewing accounting system data and workflows (QuickBooks or similar) required
Ability to synthesize complex financial and operation data into clear recommendations and solutions
Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Comfort asking probing questions to gain clarity during the proposal process
Able to adapt to ambiguous situations and exercise sound judgement
Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to prioritize workload and shift gears based on workload and project demands
Proficiency with QuickBooks and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Word
Professional, friendly and approachable demeanor with strong customer service orientation
Comfortable working with many different personality types
Team oriented and comfortable working with others in a telecommuting environment using video conferencing
Process documentation experience is a plus
Minimum Education & Training Required:
Minimum 3 – 5 years accounting experience, preferably in a Client Accounting Services (CAS) environment
Familiarity with implementation processes and procedures, preferred


Cultural Fit:

We are proud of our culture and are looking for someone who shares our G.R.I.T. values:

Grit: Motivated self-starter with a positive, can-do attitude. Demonstrates GRIT in overcoming obstacles and accomplishing tasks.
G: Expresses Gratitude and appreciation for the contributions of team members, fostering a positive and collaborative work environment
R: Demonstrates Resilience, flexibility, and determination while autonomously managing high-priority tasks and projects in an ever-evolving, dynamic work environment
I: Unquestionable commitment to upholding the highest standards of Integrity, ethical behavior, and transparency in all business practices
T: Proven ability to contribute effectively to organizational and team objectives through strong Teamwork skills

Working at AccountingDepartment.com, LLC:
The people at AccountingDepartment.com, LLC are passionate about their work and are driven by innovation. Each and every day we strive for excellence. Our work environment is equal parts casual and professional. We’re serious about our business and delivering the best service to our clients, but we also make it a priority to keep things fun and exciting.
Benefits Include:
Work from home, W-2 position
Compressed work week option available
Generous vacation and paid holidays
Group Medical, Dental, Life, Vision, Accident Insurance
401(k) plan
Participation in a company wide annual bonus incentive plan
$25 monthly internet stipend
Virtual employee groups, clubs, and activities throughout the year
Casual dress
Attention Military Spouses:

For the last 22 years, we've proudly offered 100% remote, W-2 positions, and we’ve built an environment where career continuity is more than just a buzzword – it’s a reality! Whether you’re stationed at a new base or relocating for a PCS, we offer military spouses the unique opportunity to continue your career without disruption.

As an accounting professional, you can take your position with you and keep your career on track no matter where life takes you. We believe in family first and are proud to be a family-friendly company with an award-winning culture.

If you're looking for a role that values flexibility, career growth, and a supportive work-life balance, we may just be the perfect fit for you. Join us and experience the benefits of working with a company that truly cares about its people.

How to Become Part of our Future Success:

If you believe you have what it takes to assume this new role, you must submit a resume and cover letter explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this position. Kindly include your salary requirements in the cover letter. Only candidates that submit these criteria will be considered.
